name: 認定こども園の認定要件の参照規定を変更
summary: 認定こども園の認定要件を定める条例で、保育士登録を示す条文の参照先を改めます。幼稚園型認定こども園に関する参照規定も加え、公布の日から施行します。
changes: 保育士登録の参照先を第18条の18第1項から第3項に改める
幼稚園型認定こども園について学校教育法第28条第2項で準用する規定を参照先に加える
why: 国の施設・運営基準の改正に伴い、条例の規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes references in certification requirements for certified childcare centers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Setagaya City Ordinance on Certification Requirements for Certified Childcare Centers Other Than Integrated-Type Certified Childcare Centers
en.summary: This ordinance sets the certification requirements for certified childcare centers. It changes the provision cited for nursery teacher registration and adds a reference concerning kindergarten-type certified childcare centers. It takes effect on the date of promulgation.
changes: Changes the reference for nursery teacher registration from Article 18-18, paragraph 1, to paragraph 3
Adds a reference to the provisions applied under Article 28, paragraph 2, of the School Education Act concerning kindergarten-type certified childcare centers
en.why: The ward says this is to update the ordinance provisions in response to revisions to the national standards for facilities and operations.
